nodes.description: Public string state variable 'symbol' of SymChain, set to SYMC in the constructor.
Public string state variable 'name' of SymChain, set to SymChain in the constructor.
Public uint8 state variable 'decimals' of SymChain, set to 8 in the constructor.
Internal uint '_totalSupply' holding the minted token amount 11400000000000000.
Mapping(address => uint) 'balances' storing token balances of all holders.
Nested mapping(address => mapping(address => uint)) 'allowed' storing ERC20 allowances.
Public address 'owner' of the Owned contract, the privileged account of SymChain.
Public address 'newOwner', pending owner used by the two-step ownership transfer.
SafeMath.safeAdd(uint a, uint b): computes c = a + b and requires c >= a to guard against overflow.
SafeMath.safeSub(uint a, uint b): requires b <= a and computes c = a - b to guard against underflow.
SafeMath.safeMul(uint a, uint b): computes c = a * b and validates via c / a == b.
SafeMath.safeDiv(uint a, uint b): requires b > 0 and computes c = a / b.
SymChain constructor: sets symbol/name/decimals, mints _totalSupply to a fixed address and emits Transfer.
totalSupply() constant: returns _totalSupply minus balances[address(0)].
balanceOf(address tokenOwner) constant: returns balances[tokenOwner].
transfer(address to, uint tokens): moves tokens from msg.sender using safeSub/safeAdd and emits Transfer.
approve(address spender, uint tokens): writes allowed[msg.sender][spender] and emits Approval.
transferFrom(address from, address to, uint tokens): debits balances[from] and the allowance of msg.sender, credits 'to'.
allowance(address tokenOwner, address spender) constant: returns allowed[tokenOwner][spender].
approveAndCall(address spender, uint tokens, bytes data): approves spender then calls receiveApproval on the spender contract.
Fallback function, payable, unconditionally reverts on any plain ether transfer.
transferAnyERC20Token(address tokenAddress, uint tokens) onlyOwner: pulls arbitrary ERC20 tokens to owner via external call.
Owned.transferOwnership(address _newOwner) onlyOwner: sets the pending newOwner.
Owned.acceptOwnership(): requires msg.sender == newOwner, transfers ownership and clears newOwner.
onlyOwner modifier: require(msg.sender == owner) gating privileged functions.
msg.sender, the caller-controlled address used for authentication and balance bookkeeping.
Addition operation c = a + b guarded by require(c >= a) inside safeAdd.
Subtraction operation c = a - b guarded by require(b <= a) inside safeSub.
Multiplication operation c = a * b guarded by require(a == 0 || c / a == b) inside safeMul.
External call ApproveAndCallFallBack(spender).receiveApproval(...) executed after the allowance state write.
External call ERC20Interface(tokenAddress).transfer(owner, tokens) on an arbitrary caller-supplied token contract.

edges.reason: Constructor assigns symbol = "SYMC" into the symbol state variable.
Constructor assigns name = "SymChain" into the name state variable.
Constructor assigns decimals = 8 into the decimals state variable.
Constructor assigns the initial minted supply into _totalSupply.
Constructor credits the full supply to the fixed deployer address in balances.
totalSupply() reads _totalSupply when computing the reported supply.
totalSupply() subtracts balances[address(0)] from the stored supply.
balanceOf reads the balances mapping for the queried owner.
allowance reads the allowed mapping for owner/spender pair.
transfer debits balances[msg.sender] and credits balances[to].
approve writes the granted allowance into allowed[msg.sender][spender].
transferFrom debits balances[from] and credits balances[to].
transferFrom decrements the caller's allowance in allowed[from][msg.sender].
approveAndCall writes allowed[msg.sender][spender] before the external call.
transfer uses msg.sender as the source account whose balance is debited.
approve uses msg.sender as the allowance owner key.
transferFrom uses msg.sender as the spender whose allowance is checked/debited.
approveAndCall uses msg.sender as allowance owner and as the from argument of the external call.
onlyOwner gate compares the caller-controlled msg.sender against owner to authorize execution.
acceptOwnership requires msg.sender == newOwner before granting ownership rights.
owner is the reference value compared against msg.sender in the onlyOwner modifier.
transferOwnership is restricted by the onlyOwner modifier.
transferAnyERC20Token is restricted by the onlyOwner modifier.
transferOwnership stores the candidate into newOwner.
acceptOwnership promotes newOwner to owner and then resets newOwner.
acceptOwnership overwrites the owner state variable with newOwner.
transferAnyERC20Token passes owner as the destination of the pulled ERC20 tokens.
transfer delegates the sender debit to the safeSub helper of SafeMath.
transfer delegates the recipient credit to the safeAdd helper of SafeMath.
transferFrom delegates the balance and allowance debits to safeSub.
transferFrom delegates the recipient credit to safeAdd.
safeAdd performs the a + b addition guarded by the overflow require.
safeSub performs the a - b subtraction guarded by the underflow require.
safeMul performs the a * b multiplication validated against division.
approveAndCall invokes receiveApproval on the caller-supplied spender contract after the allowance write.
The external receiveApproval call can re-enter approveAndCall/approve before the transaction state settles.
transferAnyERC20Token calls into an arbitrary tokenAddress contract supplied by the caller.
The untrusted ERC20 contract call can re-enter transferAnyERC20Token or other owner-privileged paths.
